# EEN Consulting

> Energy efficiency consulting and implementation for the Nigerian built
> environment. Certified EDGE experts and exclusive West African distributor
> of Neoperl water-saving products. Based in Lagos, Nigeria.

## What we do
- EDGE green building certification consulting and management
- Water efficiency solutions using Neoperl flow regulators and aerators (up to 70% water savings)
- Solar energy system design, installation, and maintenance for homes and businesses
- Smart metering and real-time energy monitoring
- Building Energy Efficiency Code (BEEC) compliance assessment
- Energy modelling and ROI calculations for green building projects

## Who we work with
- Property developers building homes, offices, hotels, schools, and hospitals in Nigeria
- Building owners seeking EDGE certification or green building upgrades
- Businesses looking to reduce energy and water costs
- Investors and fund managers requiring ESG-compliant building portfolios

## Certifications and partnerships
- Certified EDGE Experts (accredited by IFC, World Bank Group)
- Exclusive West African distributor of Neoperl products (German water technology)
- Partnership with Solid Green, a South African sustainability consultancy

## Where we work
Lagos, Nigeria and across the Nigerian built environment.
Office: Road 14 Adebayo Doherty, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria.
